title: outlier-aware prompt triage CI hook and report annotation integration
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: CI noise from a handful of pathological prompts often masks real regressions and causes churn on eval-based rollouts. This PR adds a lightweight outlier-aware prompt triage hook that runs as part of eval CI and surfaces a per-prompt 'prompt-outlier-index' to help automatic gating and human review. Summary of changes: Introduce eval-harness/hooks/prompt_outlier_triage.py implementing a configurable rolling-window detector (median absolute deviation, robust z-score and seasonal smoothing) that flags prompts with anomalous error rates; Add integration to eval-report pipeline to annotate prompt entries with triage tags and a suggested action (ignore/quarantine/priority-review); Add a small API adapter so CI can emit a triage artifact (JSON) and the console UI can pick up annotations; Add unit tests and an end-to-end smoke CI job; Add docs: docs/outlier-triage.md with configuration examples and recommended thresholds. Behavior and knobs: Default window=30 eval runs; default threshold=robust_z>4 or MAD>6%; group by prompt+cohort; options to suppress auto-fail for prompts marked as 'known-flaky' and to auto-quarantine when >x consecutive anomalous runs; Backfill: a historical scorer script is included to compute indices against archived eval traces. Usage: Hook is opt-in via ci/configs/eval-ci.yaml and feature flag eval.outlier_triage.enabled=false by default. Tests: unit coverage for detector logic, integration test that simulates injected outliers, CI smoke verifies artifact emission. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated in CI for two weeks, enable for a subset of repos and monitor triage volume in observability dashboards. Why this is different from existing gates: rather than thresholding a cohort metric, this focuses on per-prompt stability and provides triage metadata that can be used by humans and automated rollback logic. Related Linear tickets: ENG-7204, ENG-7289. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added; - [x] Integration smoke added; - [x] Documentation added; - [x] Feature flag + CI opt-in; - [x] Reviewed and performance scoped for CI runtime. Potential follow-ups: UI change to allow bulk-accept/quarantine, automatic creation of Linear tickets for high-priority prompts.
